en: This is a vintage postcard featuring three black-and-white photographs. The top photo shows a large, multi-story historic building with pointed gables and arched windows, likely an institutional or educational building. The bottom left photo shows a landscaped park or garden area in front of another large building. The bottom right photo shows the interior of a chapel or prayer room with rows of chairs facing an altar. The text is in Hungarian, and the postcard refers to Pécs, a city in Hungary, and the 'Szent Mór-kollégium' (Saint Maurus College).
